findings.claim: Round-4 parallel ownership is internally inconsistent because mvp-07 is said to touch src/sync while the execution plan treats it as tests-only and freezes shared core areas.
findings.evidence: mvp-07 scope says `Scope: tests | src/sync (configurable MFS root + IPNS key)` and its details say `that is the only src/sync touch`, but the execution order says Round 4 is disjoint as `src/plugin | cli/store + src/core/store/ | tests/` and `src/core outside store/ is frozen after mvp-02`.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the configurable MFS root/IPNS key work into mvp-03, or explicitly assign mvp-07 ownership of the src/sync config files and ensure no parallel change can modify or depend on them.

findings.claim: The plan gives two different changes responsibility for migrating scripts/excludes.txt defaults, creating an ordering ambiguity.
findings.evidence: mvp-02 says `One exclusion module replaces the duplicated plugin setting and scripts/excludes.txt`; mvp-03 later says it `moves excludes.txt defaults into the exclusion module`.
findings.suggested_fix: Assign the excludes.txt migration to exactly one change. If mvp-02 creates the shared exclusion module, make mvp-03 only delete obsolete shell scripts and constraints.

findings.claim: Plugin StoreAdapter wiring is promised but not actually scheduled in an executable change.
findings.evidence: mvp-06 scope is `cli/store ... | src/core/store/ only` and says `the plugin's wiring of that in-memory store waits until mvp-05 closes`, but mvp-06 is scheduled in Round 4 before mvp-05 in Round 5, and mvp-05's details do not include StoreAdapter wiring.
findings.suggested_fix: Either remove the claim that the plugin is wired to the in-memory store in MVP, or add the plugin wiring explicitly to mvp-05 or a later dependent change.
